description:
Refresh a chatbot knowledge source

Re-reads a URL knowledge source from its source page immediately and replaces the stored content with what the page says now. Website sources are also re-read on a schedule, so this is for the case where a page changed and the chatbot should know about it at once. Only entries of type `url` can be refreshed; text and file entries are rejected with 400. The entry must belong to this chatbot and to the account behind the key, otherwise the request is rejected with 404. This endpoint takes no request body.

knowledgeId.description: Identifier of the knowledge entry to refresh.

name: refresh_chatbot_knowledge
title: Refresh a chatbot knowledge source
